title: Escrow Waiver Election on a Mortgage Loan File
content:
**Terms of the election.** A borrower on a Mortgage Loan File may elect to waive the tax and insurance escrow account only where the program allows escrow waivers and the base-loan-to-value is at or below the program's maximum loan-to-value for a waiver. An escrow waiver may be recorded only when the file is not a higher-priced mortgage loan; the file's higher-priced mortgage loan indicator is the record that decides this. A higher-priced mortgage loan must keep escrow for at least the program's required number of months, so the election is refused. An accepted waiver is priced at closing at the program's escrow waiver price, a percentage of the loan amount, disclosed in the zero-tolerance bucket as a borrower-requested change.

## Election outcomes

| Program allows waivers | Base-loan-to-value at or below the waiver maximum | Higher-priced mortgage loan | Election |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | no | accepted, priced at closing |
| yes | yes | yes | refused — escrow must be kept for the required months |
| yes | no | — | not available |
| no | — | — | not available |

## Example (hypothetical file)

A file under a program with a waiver maximum of 80.00 percent and a waiver price of 0.250 percent has a base-loan-to-value of 78.50 percent, a loan amount of 300000.00 USD and is not a higher-priced mortgage loan. The election is accepted, and 0.250 percent of 300000.00 USD, which is 750.00 USD, is disclosed at closing in the zero-tolerance bucket as a borrower-requested change.
